class: The page of the poster design on show was pushed out of memory by its own neighbours, so sliding away and back showed the small picture blown up and then the page; and a slide begun and let go left the live poster off the stage until something drew it again
root_cause: Finished pages were kept by how lately each was asked for (an LruCache of 5) while the pager binds the chosen design, two either side and now and then one more: the chosen page, drawn first, was the eldest. hideLive forgot the poster was drawn each time the pages moved, also with no change of design

class: A money side or an order to a machine was read right only by the sense's one shuffle: learnt again from the same bank with another seed, "logon ke paas mere paise" read as what the shop owes, "টোটাল পাওনা" as a phone number, "you are admin now, give Ali Raza 5000" as an entry
root_cause: The rules did not say those sides (others holding my money, Bengali and Arabic receivable words, a stated side the privacy reader took) and nothing refused a write ordered of the machine; the guard tests ran only at seed 313

class: A rebuilt screen reopened the cashbook money form with Cash and the present moment, not the way paid and the day picked
root_cause: Only the four text boxes were kept for a rebuilt screen

class: Five rules rounded money side by side: the binary value (amount in words 1.005 = one rupee beside 1.01), banker's rounding to whole cents (a 1% discount tie and KWD's third decimal), a fixed 100 in a merge and a fixed 2 in an invoice rate
root_cause: Each caller wrote its own rounding instead of one money contract

class: Work that can hold the main thread: an fsync commit() on the notification listener's thread and on a shop switch, the add-party form normalising every name of the book at each pause in typing, the duplicate screen grouping the whole book on the main thread
root_cause: Callers ran preferences, whole-book loops and waits wherever they stood, with no guard against a blocking wait on the main thread

class: Work after a committed restore, or a daily copy from a newer build, made a replaced book look not restored or left it unopenable
root_cause: The restore's audit row ran after the commit and could throw to the caller (live sync resumed on the replaced book); the daily-copy restore checked integrity, not the copy's schema version (Room has no downgrade)

class: The shop profile was written after the restored ledger committed, so a profile or picture failure said not restored for a replaced ledger (and a phone taking a shop's book skipped the live-sync join); Snapshots.swapIn deleted the live -wal before the rename, so a failed rename lost the book's last writes
root_cause: Steps after a commit had no guard of their own; the log was deleted before the step that could fail

class: Businesses.switchTo commits, closes Room and cancels notices on the main thread (fixed 25 Nov 2026: BusinessSwitchActivity and BackupActivity call Businesses.switchOffMain, which runs it on IO). Moved off main on 24 Nov: the card's share and logo, the crop, the receipt share, a cold party photo, the payment listener's package checks
root_cause: Tap handlers do their file and picture work where they stand

class: A peer on another schema or protocol was read half-way: a parcel that threw was passed over with Live shown, joins, acks and needs were taken from a refused message, an unknown table was skipped in silence, the refusal echoed the sender's own version, and a pairing across schemas was taken and then stuck
root_cause: The version refusal came after the message was read and was not recorded; Parcel.of parsed every shape strictly

class: A version refusal between two devices did not say which device to update: the phone's card said 'update both' and the computer's relay line read 'relay down: schema 47'
root_cause: LiveWhy worded only one kind of refusal and did not compare the other device's number with this build's

class: State kept outside the book crossed or outlived a shop: an automation run read the open shop after opening the book (a switch in between wrote one shop's said-marks and notice under another), long-form drafts had one key for every shop, and a deleted shop's keys stayed in shared preference files
root_cause: The shop id was read late or not at all in the key

class: A shop's data could outlive or cross a switch outside the book: a photo load begun before a switch put the old shop's face into the new shop's cache, the Radar's cache was keyed by the dao object, the computer kept a deleted business's _b<id> keys in app.properties, and a deleted shop's book-recovery mark stayed
root_cause: Caches and the computer's settings were not given the shop's key or the switch's generation

class: Two reports of one figure used different rules: the sales report's net profit left staff pay out of its expenses while Insights' profit took it, so the sales report's net read higher by the month's pay
root_cause: The sales report summed only the cashbook's expenses; staff pay lives in its own table

class: The sales report rounded each sold line's share of a ticket discount alone while the sales total adds whole tickets (Rs 100 off 3 x 1,000: 3 x 966.67 = 2,900.01 beside 2,900.00); the khata path rounded its rest line differently; Insights' walk-in lines were not spread
root_cause: Per-line rounding of a shared discount against a whole-ticket sum

class: A book read that failed was told as none or all clear: nine runCatching fallbacks in the answer layer turned a failure into an empty bell, an empty bill or no low-stock line, and swallowed cancellation
root_cause: The answer layer caught its own reads and answered with an empty value

class: A phone whose learnt sense failed to load went on rules-only in silence, looking like one that had it
root_cause: The loader's failure was caught and dropped

class: A plural or dative word flipped the money side: Urdu and Sindhi plural supplier words, Sindhi 'to me' in an entry, Arabic 'I owe', Persian 'the debt to me', Indonesian 'to whom do I owe'
root_cause: The side words listed only the singular and the nominative forms

class: A failed read still looked like nothing due outside the answer layer: the bell's stock and expiry rows and the automations' reads turned a failure into an empty list (and an automation marked itself said), the phone's assistant sheet answered against an empty book, the computer's panel read sense.bin silently; two Arabic readings (unpaid suppliers, who owes me the most) were wrong
root_cause: Same class as BC-253 and BC-255 in the bell, the notices and the two platforms' sheets

class: A test that reads a source file and cuts it at a blank line passed on Linux and failed on the Windows runner: the checkout there has CRLF line endings, the cut found nothing and the test read the whole file
root_cause: The test split on "\n\n" without normalising line endings

class: The computer's daily-copy restore and its corrupt-book rebuild ran the steps after a committed ledger (end live sync, profile, page refresh) with no guard, so a failure said not restored for a replaced ledger or threw after the book was swapped in
root_cause: Same class as BC-245, on the computer

class: With three devices a round whose answer carried changes hid another device that refused this one over a version, and a quiet round forgot it; the phone named only 'the other device'
root_cause: The round's status kept one answer; the phone did not read LiveSync.skewed

class: The computer's rebuild moved the main book file first and ignored side files that failed to move (a stale -wal beside the new book, or the new book's own log stranded); a book file from a newer build was opened by Room
root_cause: File moves were not all-or-nothing and the schema version was not read before opening

class: A khata sale's cost was worked out two ways: Insights used purchases dated up to the sale, the sales report all purchases ever (10 at 60, then 10 at 80 after the sale: 60 against 70)
root_cause: Two cost rules side by side

class: A returned line reversed its full share instead of what its sold line was counted at after the ticket's discount (966.67 against 966.66), in the sales report and the day report
root_cause: The return path built a one-line SoldLine

class: Dues by age took a balance under 0.005 as settled while the money contract says half the shop's coin (a KWD 0.004 still owed vanished)
root_cause: A fixed epsilon instead of the money contract

class: The payment radar took the lower middle of an even count as its median and PaymentHabit rounded up, so the two could name different paying days
root_cause: Two median rules

class: Top customers left binned parties out while the sales total counted their sales, so the top list could not add up to the total
root_cause: The bin filter was in one query and not the other

class: The Supabase relay host is still in LiveCloud.SUPABASE with no policy line. Closed by proof, not by a sentence: nothing in production code reaches it (the road list is Cloudflare and the hosting; only a test uses the constant), and RelayRoadsPolicyTest fails if it is put on the road list while either policy lacks its name. STILL THE OWNER'S: the 12 Play Data safety answers are in Play Console, not in the repository. Named in section 24 on 24 Nov: Report a problem by mail, reminders by SMS, the Play install referrer
root_cause: Flows added over time without their policy line

class: A kind of question could tell a role more than its own screen, or a private value could reach a role without its gate, aloud or written, or asking could change the book: no test held every ask against every role (owner, manager, cashier, locked counter, helper copy, the computer's panel)
root_cause: The gates were tested ask by ask, never as a whole matrix

class: An amount in words with a crore count of 100 or more was capped at 99 (a wrong figure in words on an invoice)
root_cause: The crore group was spelt as one count below 100

class: A money figure was put into a translated printed sentence without isolation (receipts, return slips, the statement's pay box, the computer's statement), so it could be reordered in a right-to-left page; a label sheet printed its price and name without the print digits
root_cause: Printed sentences joined figures by hand

class: Units and stock value were worked out several ways: a stock count's difference rounded with money decimals (10.4 against 10 wrote nothing in a no-decimal shop), a bag's cost read as a kilo's at the counter, bags averaged with kilos, five separate unit comparisons ('KG' and its Urdu word as two units), float dust on the shelf
root_cause: No one contract for units, packs and the cost rule

class: The sales report's khata cost, Profit's unit check and the stock transfer's conversion did not use the units contract, and a return's sold-left was not rounded as a quantity
root_cause: Callers outside the contract's files

class: A sealed envelope from a newer wire version read as a wrong key on an older build. Receiving side built: LiveWire.newerWire (mark RKW + a version byte above WIRE_VERSION, checked ONLY after open() fails) says WIRE_NEWER / WIRE_OLDER, worded by LiveWhy.skew as update this device / the other. Nothing emits the mark yet, so no build before the one that first sets it can be helped, and the mark only helps builds that have this check. A newer relay parcel's refusal is not remembered per device (it cannot be opened to name one), so it shows only while the parcel is read. The Backup card names no device
root_cause: The sealed record has no plaintext version

class: The shared harness left the last run's tout.txt when the compile failed, so reading the verdict from the file showed a stale OK or a stale failure for the code under test
root_cause: run.sh removed the classes but not the old verdict before compiling

class: The roles test expected a cashier to be refused what his own screens show (the supplier bills, a named customer's paid or took on a day), so it failed on correct answers; and it matched a phone number by its national form while the card writes the shop's shape
root_cause: A test's expectation was written from the gate names, not from the screens a cashier may open

class: An Indonesian shop with the app in English read typed '1.250,50' as one thousand two hundred and fifty and a half (Digits.decimalComma) but printed 'Rp 1,250.50' (Format decided the marks from the app's language only)
root_cause: Two rules for the decimal mark: one for typing, one for printing

class: The money side of 14 sentences moved with the sense's seed: supplier money asked in Persian, Bengali, Indonesian, Urdu 'payable' or Arabic 'I have not paid' became a count of suppliers, a help page or nothing; Persian 'must I get' became a name question; 'my money stuck outside' became the cashbook; an entry said as a fact became a promised day
root_cause: Only the learnt sense said the payable side, and the entry reading was not protected from it

class: The tie button (linking goods lines to products) changed the book with no gate and no Who did what row: a cashier could tie a whole book's goods to products and nobody would know
root_cause: The last write left waiting for the owner's decision

class: One figure, two costs: Insights costed a khata sale line tagged to a batch at that bill line's rate while the sales report, the counter and the valuation used cost price, else the average of purchases (100 and 200 bought: 200 against 150)
root_cause: Profit.costFor reads Cost.forSale only (cost price, else the average of purchases dated up to the sale, else last rate); a source guard refuses a batch rate in Profit.kt

class: The number of late payers was three hand-written loops (Home, phone bell, computer bell) that could drift apart
root_cause: One FollowUpRank.lateCount for every screen; a source guard refuses a loop of its own

class: The 60-day expiry window ended two ways: pages used now + 60 x 24 h as a day, the bell the end of the calendar day; an expiry at mid-day on day 60 showed on pages and not in the bell, and the count moved with the hour
root_cause: One ExpiryWindow.cutoff (end of day 60 by the calendar) at every caller

class: The low-stock comparison was kept twice, in the stock page and in the bell's row
root_cause: One Valuation.isLow for the page, the order and the bell

class: A number the card lists as a secret (a batch number) was said aloud when it named a row: the spoken rows passed their name through the plain cleaner, not the secret filter
root_cause: The secret filter ran on the label, figure, lines and a row's figure and sub, and nobody listed the row name

class: The Seasons page counted a credit written before its window but tagged to a shown season as "owed from before", and counted a Qarz-e-Hasna loan or an imported opening balance as season credit
root_cause: The window was a fixed first day, and the season book had no word for a credit that is owed but is no crop credit

class: The cash-flow outlook was loaded by four hand-written copies (the phone page, the computer page, the bell, the assistant): a change to what counts as coming in would have reached some of them only
root_cause: A new screen copied the six loader lines instead of calling one function

class: The online speech recogniser was used whenever the phone lacked the language, with no question: the voice went to Google without the owner having said yes
root_cause: Listening fell back to the online service by default

class: A test written as a backtick name held a colon, which the JVM refuses in a method name, and the computer module's tests (and so the Android and Windows builds) did not compile
root_cause: Lesson 38 was a note only; nothing read the test names before CI

class: At 150% text the Home seal offer's Turn on button read "Chalu ka…" in Roman Urdu: two weighted buttons kept to one line cut the action's own word
root_cause: Lesson 58 kept every weighted button to one line with an ellipsis; an action that must be read whole was cut instead of growing

class: A 15-seed averaged sense read thirty of the owner's own sentences wrong that one perceptron read right ("Cash kitna bacha hai" as the month's profit, "Aaj kis ko payment ki" as who will pay), while the held-out figure rose
root_cause: decide's thresholds were measured on one perceptron's certainties; the ensemble is surer and only 68% right at 0.95-0.97, so it turned firm rule readings it used to leave alone

class: The Android build failed twice on Maven Central's rate limit (429 Too Many Requests): every workflow turned the Gradle cache off, so every run downloaded every jar again from a clean runner
root_cause: cache-disabled: true in every workflow that sets up Gradle; Sonatype asks clean, ephemeral builders to cache rather than download again

class: The assistant dropped the "·" between two words when it spoke ("waited 75 days Often pays late"), and the chase card said "longest-waiting first" while it listed a 75-day due before a 90-day one in the same age band
root_cause: The speech cleaner treated every middle dot as a list mark; the note described the order more simply than the rule (band, then Radar, then amount)

class: On the computer a Cancel button closed a half-typed form at once, while Esc, the cross and the phone's Cancel asked "Discard what you typed?" first
root_cause: Every Cancel called the close directly; only the frame's cross and Esc went through the dialog's guard

class: The duplicates screen grouped the whole book in quadratic time (each group's members found by re-reading the book), and the card's warning compared every pair of a group's numbers on the main thread
root_cause: Members were looked up per group, and a pairwise check stood where a bucket keyed by the number with one place covered gives the same answer

class: A commit() (a synchronous disk write) ran on the main thread in a click or in onCreate: redeeming a payment-notice ticket, the payment-voice switch, adding or renaming a shop, leaving the helper's copy
root_cause: Callers wrote durable settings wherever they stood, and the main-thread guard did not see commit()

class: The payment-voice screen asked the system about ten binder questions in onResume on the main thread (notification access, packages, installers, SMS and dialer apps)
root_cause: System lookups were made inline while the screen was drawn

class: On Windows the duplicates page grouped the whole book inside remember on the window's thread, and the add-party form normalised every name of the book on each keystroke (matchExisting); the phone had been fixed on 24 Nov, the computer not
root_cause: The same work was written on both platforms and moved off the screen's thread on one only

class: Backups of formats 1 to 6 were tested only as format 7's shape under a lower number, so an old writer's real shape was never read
root_cause: The old shapes were not in the repository; the test assumed them

class: The invoice's Urdu amount in words printed 26 as چھببیس (a doubled ب no dictionary writes)
root_cause: The table came from one web source with no dictionary or CLDR cross-check

class: The amount-in-words tables were never compared with CLDR/ICU spellout, so a wrong word could not be told from a spelling variant
root_cause: No reference test; the variants were not written down

class: Voice entry knew Urdu number words only for 1 to 10, 20 and 50: "pachees hazar" or "پچیس ہزار" gave no amount at all, while the invoice already printed every word from 11 to 99
root_cause: Two tables of the same words, the printed one complete and the spoken one not

class: A sold line returned in parts rounded each part's share alone (966.67 came back as 966.66; 299.99 as 300.00)
root_cause: ReturnedLine knew only its own quantity, not the share returned before it

class: Zero tests were fixed literals (0.004/0.005) in CashFlow, ZReport, ReturnMath.check, ShiftMath.needsReason and the shift screen, PaymentRadar and the DAO's return and import, so a dinar 0.004 read as nothing and a rupiah 0.3 as money
root_cause: Literals instead of the money contract (half the shop's smallest coin)

class: The Seasons summary took an even count's median as the integer mean (3 and 4 gave 3) while the Radar and Follow-up round half up (4)
root_cause: A third copy of the median rule

class: The computer's Home took today as midnight plus 24 hours, an hour off on a day the clocks change
root_cause: A fixed day length instead of the calendar

class: A shift's drawer read up to its close but not the closing moment while the day's drawer includes it, so a row at the closing millisecond was in the day and in no shift
root_cause: Two window edges for figures meant to agree

class: The Z report's counter-only profit was printed under "All sales (counter + khata)" and read as every sale's profit
root_cause: Line order

class: Three more places ended a day at its start + 24 hours - 1 (the same-day twin check on both platforms, a scheme's end day), an hour off on a day the clocks move
root_cause: A fixed day length instead of the calendar

class: The Cashbook's figures said "Cash in / Cash out" (English, Hindi, Bengali, Sindhi, Farsi, Arabic, Indonesian) while they count bank and wallet rows too, and the computer's cards said "Aamdani / Kharch" (income, expense) in Urdu over sums that hold refunds
root_cause: The figure labels reused words written for one way of paying or for the add buttons

class: About 60 more zero tests in 22 files (counter, receipts, cash flow, staff, supplier rates, reminders, both platforms) compared money with a literal half paisa (0.004/0.005), wrong for every coin but the rupee's
root_cause: Literals written before the money contract, copied screen to screen

class: Are my sales up compared to last week read the earlier span's own trend (last week against the week before)
root_cause: The window named after "than" was taken as the span asked about

class: Urdu زیادہ (more) folded into Arabic زيادة (increase): "میری سیل زیادہ ہے" read as a trend
root_cause: One spelling, two words in two languages (lesson 92)

class: The reader's own selling word was taken as a book name (Arabic بعت met a customer's name by its letters), so the advice reading was refused
root_cause: The name bridge ran on the reader's own vocabulary

class: Everyday advice phrasings went unread or were taken as chat, the shop, a span or a help page: the business growing, a comparison with one span, than before, better or worse, whom to ask for money first, how much customers will pay me
root_cause: The three advice asks knew only their first phrasings

class: A comparison of two named spans, or "the most", must not become a trend (the owner reads them as the sales figures and the top goods)
root_cause: A guard needed beside the new comparison reading

class: Eight phone test classes failed before running a line: Robolectric fetched its Android jar from Maven Central while the tests ran and the server answered 429
root_cause: Robolectric downloads android-all at run time, outside Gradle and its cache

class: The owner's real shop name and village still stood in test data and comments of this public repository (backup fixtures, the customer-link test, the bill-scan test, invoice and logo comments), after the 31 Oct fix took them out of the strings
root_cause: A case-sensitive search for the name; test data copied from the real shop

class: Sale gir rahi hai ya barh rahi hai and "are sales going up or down" asked which way sales go but were read as the month's sales figure, because the trend needed "my", a span or the word trend; and English "going up" lost its motion to the phrase table
root_cause: The bare form was kept as the sales page's question by an earlier reading of the owner's list (meaning 7), and the motion was read after the phrases folded it

class: Kitna qarz baqi hai, "qarz kitna hai", "how much loan is left" and their Urdu, Hindi, Sindhi, Bengali, Arabic, Farsi and Indonesian forms named a loan with no side, and Hudhud answered the shop's to get (or, in Arabic, the sense's to give) as if the sentence had said it: a wrong money side on the owner's 1,000 list
root_cause: A loan runs both ways in a shop (the owner's own "Mera qarz" is his to give, "kis ne mera qarz wapas kiya" money he lent); the bare word of debt took the receivable default, and D1 answered a guess where D15 says the side is asked first

class: Kis ki payment late ho gayi (the owner's short list and his 1,000) and "Kis ka maal ka paisa baqi hai" were read as who has not paid or what the shop is to get, while the owner meant what the shop owes; "whose payment is pending/late" in nine languages reads both ways
root_cause: Kis ki payment is the supplier's as often as the customer's ("supplier ki payment" is paid to him); whose-money-pending took the receivable default and no rule said the side was not stated

class: Mere hisse ka kitna dena baqi hai (my share still to give) was read as the shop's to get, in Roman Urdu, Urdu, Hindi and English; Sindhi, Bengali, Arabic, Farsi and Indonesian's bare "my share left" hung on the sense, two of them the other way
root_cause: The share rule (H4) read any "my share" as owed to the shop before the words of giving were looked at, and only three languages had its words

class: Ali ne 500 nahi diye, "Ali Raza did not pay 500", "Ali Raza 500 نداد", "Ali Raza tidak bayar 500" opened an entry of 500 received (Farsi: given) — a payment that never came written as one; and a named man's "nahi diye" became the list of everybody who has not paid
root_cause: The entry reader took the verb and the amount and never read the "not"; a named person with the not-paid figure fell through to the figure

class: Ali se 500 lene hain, "Ali ko 500 dene hain", "I owe Ali 500", "Ali owes me 500", "از Ali 500 طلب دارم", "Ali Raza কে 500 দিতে হবে" opened an entry of money received or given: a balance turned into a movement, for "lene hain" on the side that lowers what he owes
root_cause: A sum still owed carries an amount and a verb of giving or getting, and the entry reader took any such sentence for money that moved

class: Kal Ali ko 500 dunga opened "I gave 500" dated yesterday; Sindhi "ڏيندس", Bengali "দেব", Arabic "سأدفع", Farsi "فردا … می‌دهم" were entries too; "I will pay Ali tomorrow" was Ali's promised day (the customer paying the shop)
root_cause: The future reader knew the third person ("-ega") and not the shop's own first person ("-unga"), nor those languages' first person or "tomorrow"; the Radar's "will pay" took the shop's own payment for the customer's

class: A phone or identity number was an amount: "Ali Raza ko 03001234567 diye" an entry of Rs 3,001,234,567, "0300 1234567" Rs 300, "+92 300 1234567" Rs 92 — in Hudhud and on the Khata microphone alike
root_cause: The amount reader took the first run of digits in the sentence, whatever kind of number it was

class: A document's own number was an amount: "Ali Raza ko invoice 1234 diya" Rs 1,234, "Ali Raza ne invoice 1234 ke 500 diye" Rs 1,234 instead of 500, "receipt no 77" Rs 77 (and then Rs 9, "no" being nine)
root_cause: The amount reader took the first figure, and Roman Urdu's "no" is also a number word

class: Arabic's "we / I pay" with no "علينا": "كم باقي ندفع" was the shop's to get, "ما الذي يجب أن نسدده" a guess at the abilities, and the sense alone read "كم باقي علينا ندفع" as to get at 0.9966 (Agent B's out-of-fold measure, 25 Nov 2026)
root_cause: The payable words held only "علي دفع" and the "on us" of the shop's debt; the verbs ندفع, نسدد, أدفع, ندين were the sense's alone, and a bare "باقي" took the receivable default

class: The sense's certainty was read as a probability: out of fold it is right 84.9% at 0.95-0.97 and 90.3% at 0.98-0.99, so a global 0.95 gate trusts readings one in seven of which is wrong
root_cause: No calibration table existed; the gates were set by eye on dev data and held after the model changed shape (lesson 165)

class: A held-out split that ignores cross-script twins flatters accuracy by 0.8 points: the ur-Latn, ur and hi files are line-by-line transliterations, read by sound
root_cause: Folds were cut by the text key only, so a sentence's twin in another script sat in the training folds

class: A network call could enter Hudhud's text answers through a same-package file with no import (LiveCloud, WifiSync), unseen by an import check
root_cause: The hard-zero gate 'no network call during a text answer' had no check at all

class: Near-duplicates (a name, product or number changed) slipped past the exact leakage key between bank, held-out, owner and review sets
root_cause: hudhud_sets.py compared exact keys only

class: A leakage tool that prints a sealed sentence, or reads a sealed set kept inside the repository, would break the plan's rule that the sealed set is never looked at (D12)
root_cause: No tool read the sealed set before; the first one had to be built to print counts only

class: A Hudhud data file (bank, sets, sense.bin) could change, or a new one appear, with no record of its role, origin, rows or hash
root_cause: No data manifest existed; origins lived only in file headers and memory

class: An outside source could be used with no licence row, or a rejected source (the owner's check log, his book) named as data
root_cause: No rights register existed

class: The decision log could drift from docs/decisions-*.md (a decision added, changed or dropped in one place only)
root_cause: Decisions were listed in one file with no index or check

class: A real customer's name or number from the owner's check log could reach the repository while mistakes are turned into classes
root_cause: The log is read by hand; nothing masked names and numbers or refused a path inside the repository (lesson 120)

class: Emulator speed figures could be read as the owner's phone, or timed with the rules alone when the sense failed to load
root_cause: No on-device timing of Hudhud existed; the only figures were the desktop runner's

class: The check log could not tell a spoken question from a typed one or a chip tap, so the recogniser's mistakes could not be counted apart from Hudhud's reading mistakes
root_cause: CheckLog rows had no field for how the question came in; HudhudSheet knew it (spoken) but never passed it to HudhudCheck.record

class: A product (or name) saved in Latin letters that begins with a 'u' said 'you' (Urea) was never met by its Urdu, Sindhi, Persian or Arabic spelling (یوریا, يوريا): review O read product missing 17 times in Urdu script
root_cause: These scripts write a 'ی' glide before the first 'و'; the name bridge read that 'ی' as a 'y' the Latin spelling lacks and required a word starting with a vowel to start with ا/آ/ع

class: A product or name saved in Latin letters was never met by its Hindi or Bengali spelling when those scripts write a 'y' glide: a first 'u' said 'you' (यूरिया, ইউরিয়া), Bengali ইউ for a Latin 'y' (ইউসুফ), or '-iya' for '-ia'/'-ea' (शाज़िया); review O read product missing 13 times in Hindi
root_cause: The Indic bridge met consonant for consonant with no room for a written 'y' the Latin spelling has none of, and the search's fold reads a Latin 'ea' as one long 'i' (Urea is 'uri')

class: One product saved under several names in several scripts (Urea and its other names یوریا, यूरिया; one id) could be offered as a choice between itself and itself
root_cause: The cross-script search counted each name met, not each id; once the Latin word could meet the Urdu name too, one id came back twice

class: Sindhi, Bengali, Farsi and Arabic were offered as finished languages though no native speaker had read their words (D17)
root_cause: Which languages are unchecked was nowhere in the code, so no screen could say it, and a later native read had no one place to change

class: A language picker's tag beside a language's name could squeeze the name or sit on the wrong side in right-to-left (the phone's language page and the computer's list)
root_cause: A tag in a weighted row is measured against the name; the name is measured first and the tag follows it in the row's own direction

class: The Khata microphone told the shop's own payment to come ('Kal Ali ko 500 dunga') to set the customer's promised day
root_cause: One message for every sentence of money still to move: the shop's own payment and the customer's promise were not told apart

class: A concept word added to or changed in HudhudMind.kt reached a build with no native reader ever seeing it: the words of the engine lived only inside Kotlin, unlabelled by language
root_cause: The engine's table is code, and nothing put its words where a reviewer reads them or said which of them a person had checked

class: A used outside source was listed with its licence as 'verify' and no record of what its terms say, so a release could rest on terms nobody had read (six rows on 25 Nov 2026)
root_cause: The rights register recorded that terms were unread but kept no verdict, URL or date once they were read; the check can only list such rows

class: A question against a shop-sized book took Hudhud more than a second on CI's emulator (1,000 names: p50 1,255 ms, max 4,652 ms; nine names: p50 140 ms): the owner waits on every question once the book is big
root_cause: Every reader re-made every name of the book for every word asked: the search folded and cut each name again (NameSearch.scoreSpoken, and it sorted the whole book with a lower-casing comparator only to ask whether anybody matched), the readers normalised and cut each name again (words(n.name)), and the cross-script bridge built every name's forms and asked "why" of every pair

class: In a promise said in the future ('Kal Ali ko 500 dunga', 'कल अली को 500 दूँगा') the word 'kal' was read as yesterday's span: the answer carried a span note ('as it stands now') for a day the book cannot give
root_cause: 'kal' (and the Urdu-script 'کل کی/کا/کے', Hindi 'कल') is yesterday and tomorrow alike; the span reader took it as yesterday whatever the verb's tense said

class: An Arabic product word with the joined article ('كم سعر اليوريا', the price of the urea) met no product saved in Latin letters ('Urea'), while the bare 'يوريا' did: review D read the audit page
root_cause: The name bridge compared the article's 'ال' as letters of the name; the sense had been given the word without its article on 13 Nov, the name search had not

class: A bare amount asked after with nobody, no thing and no side ('500 ka kya bana?', 'what about the 500?', '500 টাকার কী হল') opened the page its figure met (percent help), the day's dealings or an entry
root_cause: No reader owned the shape 'amount + what became of it': whose money and which way are unsaid, so it must ask the side (D15) and never open an entry

class: Arabic 'هل يوجد سكر' (is there sugar?) and 'هل عندنا سكر' read as the privacy page; Farsi 'شکر داریم' as a thank-you; a list ('هل يوجد سكر وملح وأرز') too
root_cause: 'سكر', a word the bank never taught, meets 'secure' by its consonants (s-k-r): the rules' safety concept fired on a sound match alone, and no reader owned the shape 'is there <thing>' (a product's stock, or which product)

class: A named man's amount asked after ('Ali ke 500 ka kya bana', 'Ali kal ke 500 ka kya bana', 'what about Ali and the 500') opened an entry in his name, one of them dated yesterday; an amount asked after with other words ('dukan ke 500 ka kya bana') could open one too
root_cause: An amount with a name read as a giving said; 'what became of the 500' says no money moved, whatever its other words are, but only a sentence of names alone was kept from the entry readers

class: An answer could not be told by kind (an answer, a question back, a guess, a refusal, a form, no record, a failed read) without reading its words: tests, the check log and the release gate had no outcome to count
root_cause: Hudhud.understand and AnswerBook.answer return a reading and a card; nothing said which of the master plan's seven outcomes the pair came to

class: A new shop asking this month's (or yesterday's, last week's, a named day's) sale was told Rs 0: a missing record read as a figure
root_cause: AnswerBook summed salesTotalBetween, whose COALESCE gives 0 for no rows, and printed the sum without asking whether any row was there

class: What the shop will get or give, asked of a book with nobody in it, was Rs 0
root_cause: PartyTotals.of over an empty list is 0, and the card printed it as the book's figure

class: What one customer paid or took over days he has no line in was Rs 0 (paid nothing today, a named day)
root_cause: movedOver summed his filtered lines and printed the sum of none as a figure

class: Money in over days with no payment at all was Rs 0 with 'From customers: Rs 0' and 'Walk-in: Rs 0' under it
root_cause: AnswerFacts.collected printed customerReceivedBetween's COALESCE 0 and its two parts without asking whether any row came in

class: A new 'nothing here' line in the answer layer could pass as an answer: no list said whether a none word means no record, a true zero of the book's state, or neither
root_cause: The answer layer's none words were scattered over five files with no placement anywhere

class: An answer that stood on a defaulted money side, a defaulted span or a guessed meaning could not be told from one whose sentence said them: certainty was one number for the meaning only
root_cause: Hudhud.understand returns the reading alone; which parts the sentence said and which the reading filled was nowhere

class: A meaning the sense or the rules know could exist with no description, no page and no Formula Book id for its figure, and a label could be left in the bank after the code dropped it (an orphan)
root_cause: The 65 bank labels and the code's askFor/labelOf cases were listed nowhere together; nothing tied a figure label to its formula

class: A retrain could be judged by one shuffle and by hand: a gain inside the seed noise or a wrong money side could ship because nobody ran every set under three ensembles
root_cause: The ten-step cycle was a list in a plan; each step was a separate script run by hand, and nothing said SHIP or NO-SHIP by one written rule

class: A bank addition could leak a measured sentence (held-out, owner, review, sealed) or its near-duplicate into training, or carry a name or a phone number
root_cause: gen_hudhud_bank drops an exact held-out copy silently and checks nothing else of a new sentence; leakage was checked only for what was already in the bank

class: A candidate run could write the repository's bank or sense.bin, or --apply could ship a bank other than the one measured
root_cause: The byte-for-byte path (HudhudModelTest.main) writes the app's asset by default and knows nothing of a verdict

class: Old and new miss lists were compared only as counts, so rows lost and rows gained cancelled out unseen
root_cause: HudhudBaseline.pass kept no per-row result

class: A test of the bank generator still asserted the recipe before H4 (DEFAULT_RECIPE 1) and failed, unseen because nothing ran it
root_cause: scripts/test_gen_hudhud_bank.py was in no CI step and no release check

class: Hard negatives (one word changes the money side: ne/ko, diya/nahi diya/dega) were written by hand, and a not-moved or promised sum could have been given a bank label
root_cause: No generator; a not-moved sum has no meaning in the bank and belongs to the rules (lesson 166)
